document.title: Themes: one file gives the review UI a project's colours
document.summary: A `.comprehende/theme.json` sets the UI colours, and the skill can write one. Screenshot runs can also use a theme.
document.why: [#184](source:s1) asks to let users customize the color scheme from a config file that the CLI and UI read deterministically.

sources.label: PR #207
sources.title: Themes: one file gives the review UI a project's colours
sources.gist: Theme file, skill setup flow, cigster demo.

parts.name: screenshots
parts.summary: `ui:screenshots` can shoot the UI with a theme.

groups.title: Theme file and its check
groups.summary: `themeSchema` in `src/schema/theme.ts` defines the file, and `loadTheme` finds it in the repository root, else in the home folder, as [#184](source:s1) asks.

attention.note: A value must be a literal colour: hex of 3, 4, 6, or 8 digits, or a colour function with numeric arguments. `{"dark":{"primary":"var(--brand)"}}` fails the parse, so a theme cannot point at the project's own variables. The repository file wins whole: a home file that sets `ring` gives nothing when the project file exists.

fileNotes.src/api/theme.test.ts: Covers precedence, fallback, bad values, and tokens missing from `styles.css`.

groups.title: Theme in the review payload
groups.summary: `openReview` loads the theme beside the repository identity, and `reviewPayload` sends it as `theme`, so an export carries it in `api/review.json`.

attention.note: `loadTheme` throws on an invalid file, and `openReview` lets the error through. A broken `~/.comprehende/theme.json` makes `serve` and `export` fail in every repository without a project theme, until the user fixes it. The error names the file and the field.

fileNotes.src/api/live.ts: `ReviewContext` gains `theme`; `serve` re-reads it on each request.
fileNotes.src/api/export.test.ts: Exports a repo with a theme; `api/review.json` must hold it.

groups.title: UI adopts the theme
groups.summary: `App` calls `applyCustomTheme` in a layout effect, which adopts one sheet that sets the variables over `styles.css` in each mode.

attention.note: `--diff-canvas` is now `var(--card)` in `styles.css`. The built-in values match, so the default look stays the same, but a theme that sets `card` now also repaints the diff background unless it sets `diff-canvas` too.

fileNotes.src/ui/App.tsx: Applies the theme before paint, and removes it on change.
fileNotes.src/ui/styles.css: Drops the unused `--add-bg` and `--del-bg`; canvas follows `--card`.

groups.title: `theme` command
groups.summary: `comprehende theme` prints `ok <path>` or the two paths it looked at, and `serve` and `export` print the theme path they use.

fileNotes.src/cli/args.ts: Adds `theme` to the commands and the usage text.
fileNotes.src/cli/main.ts: Runs `loadTheme` on the repo root; a bad file exits 1.
fileNotes.README.md: Documents the setup prompt, the home fallback, and the command.

groups.title: Skill: set up a theme
groups.summary: `SKILL.md` sends a theme request to the new `references/theme.md`, before the refresh branch; that file maps a project's colours to the tokens and runs `theme`.

attention.note: The theme steps run `<cli> theme`, but the skill pins `npx comprehende@0.13.4`, which has no `theme` command. Until the next release bumps the pin, the flow works only with a local executable.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: Adds the theme trigger to the description and the branch line.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/theme: New: file shape, token roles, and four steps with WCAG 4.5:1 checks.

groups.title: Synced skill copies
groups.summary: `pnpm sync:skill` copies the skill edits to `.agents/skills/comprehende/`. Skip them: they match `skills-next/` and the `check:skill` hook checks that.

groups.title: Screenshots with a theme
groups.summary: `ui:screenshots --theme <file>` copies the file into the case repository as its theme. A run without the flag writes `{}` there, so a home theme cannot reach it.

fileNotes.scripts/ui-screenshots.ts: `buildRepo` always writes `.comprehende/theme.json` into the case checkout.

commits.subject: Themes: stricter colour check, no first-paint flash, default shots ignore a home theme

commits.subject: Skill: theme steps from two simulated cigster runs
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Read only the files that define colours, resolve palette steps at the locked version, keep warn apart from an amber brand, and check contrast as WCAG ratios.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Themes: a .comprehende/theme.json sets the UI colours
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The CLI reads the theme from the repository root, else the home folder, and passes it to serve and export in the review payload. The UI adopts it over styles.css. A new theme command checks the file, and the skill gains a theme setup flow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
